description:
Query measured signal behaviour: describe, pick, find or gap_probability.

[Access: pay 0.005 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

category.description: find: restrict to one family, e.g. oscillator, volatility, momentum

lookup.description: describe: one signal -- parameter meanings, measured span, what its default measures. pick: settings of one signal that hit target_rate. find: which signals reach a rate band. gap_probability: share of a signal's gaps inside a range of bar lengths, per configuration.

max_gap_bars.description: pick/find, TRIGGER only: median gap at most this many bars

max_gap_range_bars.description: gap_probability: high end of the gap range, inclusive (required)

max_rate.description: find: high end of the band, same units (required)

max_run_bars.description: pick/find, FILTER only: mean run at most this many bars

min_gap_bars.description: pick/find, TRIGGER only: median gap at least this many bars

min_gap_range_bars.description: gap_probability: low end of the gap range, inclusive (required)

min_rate.description: find: low end of the band, same units (required)

min_run_bars.description: pick/find, FILTER only: mean run at least this many bars

signal.description: Signal name, e.g. rsi_oversold. Required by describe, pick, gap_probability

signal_type.description: FILTER (an ongoing state) or TRIGGER (a one-bar event); measured separately

target_rate.description: pick: rate to aim for -- FILTER selectivity 0-1, TRIGGER firings per 1,000 bars. Omit to list the span

name: query_signal_behavior
